name: ast_blast_radius

test_list.description: Report an estimated syntactic call-site count and its test-site subset for a changed signature.
Ignore implementation body changes whose declarations and signatures are unchanged.
Keep missing or unknown index results incomplete instead of presenting them as zero callers.
Reject internally inconsistent counts and propagate reference-index failures.
Bound changed-symbol enumeration for large or hostile skeleton diffs.

output_description: Changed declaration signatures and conservative syntactic caller estimates.
